'''October 2001 Livingston tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Livingston, NJ on 27 October 2001. [[Kelly Krieble]] won it. It is known from Kelly Krieble's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3079">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-28-livingston-nj-10-27-01d3079/ livingston-nj-10-27-01], DeckTech (Kelly "dr_divot" Krieble, 28 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-28-livingston-nj-10-27-01d3079/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 27 October 2001
* '''Site:''' Livingston, NJ
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Kelly Krieble]]
